chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), when he intended to perform the 'Umrah, would wait until the morning of the twenty-third of the month of Ramadan, then he would go out commencing (the 'Umrah) during that day.

key_terms.يَخْرُجُ مُهِلًّا: He goes out commencing (with the declaration of Ihram)

ai.seo_question: When is the recommended time to perform 'Umrah according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the specific devotional practice of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who preferred to commence the ritual state of Ihram for Umrah on the morning of the 23rd of Ramadan. This timing is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the recommended act of Umrah from the obligatory Hajj, emphasizing the spiritual merit of aligning pilgrimage rituals with the latter days of Ramadan, a period of heightened divine grace.
